title: Uninspiring Product
text: Uninspiring Product. A bit disappointed with this product. The quality is mediocre at best. This only fits over a standard interior door. Will not fit a metal door. The finish is kind of fragile. I actually managed to scratch it up removing it from the packaging. I think it says this is a satin finish, but it is not like any other "satin" finish I've seen. Kind of cloudy over the metal. Don't expect this to hold very much weight besides some light clothes or jackets. Might be good for a bathroom at best.

description: Zenna Home bathroom accessories add stylish, modern flair and functionality to your home. This butterfly hook features four hooks to hang robes, towels, and clothes, a durable metal construction, foam pad to protect door from damage, and a satin chrome finish. Fits over standard interior doors with a thickness of 1.37''. Measures 4''L x 5.6''W x 7.4''H.
